ConfigurableProduct:16290.faq:
What materials are these labels made from?

These labels are made from high quality vinyl with a lovely gloss finish.

What happens if I put it on crooked?

If you've placed it on lightly, then you should be able to slowly remove it and start again.

Will these labels work in the dishwasher?

Yes, these labels will stay stuck to most smooth containers in the dishwasher.

What can these labels be used on?

They can be easily stuck to lunch boxes & bento boxes with a lid that has a smooth surface. Being 100% waterproof they’re safe to use on most containers in dishwashers, sterilisers, microwaves and freezers. For further information, please see our FAQ Page

Made from the highest quality vinyl, 100% Waterproof, Dishwasher Safe & Microwave Friendly, our labels always stay stuck.

You'll also love our popular Designer School Labels hit with 200 waterproof name labels for things like clothes, stationery, hats, drink bottles & more.

Round Name Label size: 9cm (3.5").

We recommend applying these labels to lunch boxes & bento boxes with a lid that has a smooth surface.

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.
